facts: Parties: Kingsmere Medical Ltd (Buyer), Orwell Medical Ltd (Seller); the Company is Dunmore Energy plc.
This Agreement is dated 27 December 2026; Closing is scheduled for 31 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.5 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $25,200,000. The Purchase Price is $210,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Redcliffe Systems Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
